title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is correct: v_B = √[2g(H - h + r sin θ)].

title: Force Magnitude at B
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is correct: F = √[(2Δmg(H-h)/r + 3Δmg sin θ)² + (Δmg cos θ)²].

title: Horizontal Range
description: Essential: Final answer for part (3) is correct: x = 2√[h(H - h)] or equivalent simplified form.

title: Energy Conservation Setup
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem correctly to find v_B, using the correct vertical drop (H - h + r sin θ).

title: Centripetal Force at B
description: Important: For part (2), correctly applies Newton's second law radially at point B, identifying the net force as mv²/r.

title: Projectile Motion Setup
description: Important: For part (3), correctly finds v_C from energy conservation and uses kinematics (h = ½gt²) to find flight time.

title: Force Components Resolution
description: Optional: Correctly resolves the pipe force on the water at B into radial and tangential components before combining.

title: Incorrect Height Term
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect vertical drop in the energy equation (e.g., omitting the r sin θ term for v_B).

title: Sign Error in Force
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the radial force balance at B (e.g., incorrect relative direction of gravity component).

title: Unit or Factor Error
description: Pitfall: Final numerical answers have missing factors (like a factor of 2) or incorrect units/dimensions.
